lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Web 2 to lower flange 4 at about 56 deg. In the sections at 25/50/75% the line sits on the outer arc where the bisector crosses it (0.02-0.06 mm off), and the inner skin is about 1.8 mm inside. The fold extends at most about 1 mm past the line ends.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Web 2 to upper strip 7 at about 50 deg, on the outer apex in all three sections. It covers the full length of the strip's fold, which ends at the relief slot on the left and the B5 step on the right.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Web 2 to end plate 5 at about 50 deg. The plane of plate 5 is offset about 6.1 mm from strip 7's plane, and extending B2 leaves it about 8 mm from B3, so this is a separate fold and not B2 interrupted by a relief. The line is on the outer apex and covers the visible fold.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Web 2 to right-end down flange 15 at 90 deg. The line is on the arc apex (about 1.7 mm inside the sharp corner, which is right for a 90 deg bend with R about 2t). It covers the flange width; the flat holed lug beside it is not a bend.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Holed tab 17, about 9 mm wide, bent 88 deg from the end edge of the web step. The section shows a real formed arc and the line is on the outer apex. 8.5 mm covers the fold between the tab's corner radii.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Web 1 to short wall 14 at 90 deg at the left end of the lower edge. All sections show a formed arc with the line on the outer apex. The fold runs only about 1.5 mm past the end, so coverage is about 93%.

lines.label: B7
lines.reason: Wall 11 to holed tab 9 at about 40 deg (inside angle 140 deg). The line is on the outer apex in all sections and covers the whole width of the tab.

lines.label: B8
lines.reason: Web 1 to left end flange 13 at 90 deg. The line is on the arc apex in all sections and covers the flange width.
